Lyonette’s head felt foggy. She was falling asleep.
Lyonette didn’t want to mention she had consolidated her [Beast Tamer] class into [Worldly Princess].
And so that was what Lyonette was doing. Doing what all [Princesses] did, in their heads, in their hearts. In reality.
She eyed Lyonette. The [Princess] was sitting in Zevara’s office.
Erin stared at Lyonette. The [Worldly Princess] snapped.
Benefits. Pawn had leveled up. He was a [Priest]. Level 24. He had gained a new Skill. Well—not a Skill per se. Lyonette was very excited about it.

“Honestly, I don’t know how your class works, Pawn. It’s so—unique. Mine? I’m very glad about being a [Worldly Princess]. Otherwise, only royal acts would allow me to level. Which is why most of the royalty are under-leveled compared to everyone else. Well—we also level slower.”
Erin looked at Lyonette for confirmation. The [Worldly Princess] raised her head; she was reading something.
Mrsha and Pawn sprinted at Lyonette as Ishkr bent over her. The [Princess] felt everything going dark. She panted as Pawn seized her.
But it was interesting to Lyonette because she was a [Princess]. And a [Worldly Princess] at that. One of her Skills that she had often not needed to use had activated.
Lyonette sighed. She respected that, actually. It was just—they were doing it to her. She sat there, thinking.
The problem was—she was a [Princess]. And it occurred to Lyonette now that a [Princess] wasn’t the person who charged into battle. Or if she did—it was with an army at her back.
Lyonette woke up from a nap with a single faerie flower on her blankets. Feathi ate it and then went cross-eyed—or as much as a horse could. Lyonette eyed her chest and sighed in relief.
She was leveling her [Worldly Princess] class.
Lyonette’s face regained color as the failed assassination attempt ended.
Lyonette had never been called on as much for these sorts of duties

The two tipped hats. Lyonette saw Wilovan take a huge breath. He turned, and smiled jauntily at a mob of low-level, deadly, unscrupulous men and women. Then he bellowed, for perhaps the first time in memory.
Lyonette didn’t make as if to rise. She put the letter on the corner of her desk, and looked at it. Saliss peered at her.
The Drake nodded. He was watching Lyonette. Gone was her carefree smile. As she sat there, Lyonette du Marquin was cold.

Lady Magnolia looked at Lyonette. A day had passed since the ball where she had proposed her joint effort between north and south. A day since Lyonette du Marquin had survived a flagrant assassination attempt by Oteslia’s biggest gang, and been revealed as a [Princess] by the Thronebearers.
Lyonette the Fiery! Lyonette the disgrace!
Lyonette had shot up to Level 28 in record time, consolidated her class
Lyonette finally had all the fun she had been missing.
No more the [Worldly Princess]; she had found another calling.
